title: Open Policy Agent before 1.20.0 Symlink File Overwrite via Predictable OCI Store Path
description: A vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-137570 affects Open Policy Agent versions before 1.20.0, allowing a symlink file overwrite via a predictable OCI store path. The issue relates to improper handling of symbolic links, potentially enabling unauthorized file overwrites. The affected version explicitly noted is version 3.0 of a Microsoft product, though the description references Open Policy Agent. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
